config.reset_protocol: canonical demo_0 frame0 only, at explicit episode reset
config.initial_weights: verified frozen public pretrained visual backbone; fresh random Actor/Critic/adapters; empty online replay; no smoke/old RL checkpoint
config.resume_boundary: learner/replay/RNG restore; pending real tails truncated, all workers start NEW episodes; no mid-episode physics restore
config.notes: UTD is critic updates per valid real interaction after warmup; actor updated once per such interaction. No baseline or algorithm ablations.

supervisor_config.window_rule: L = P1-P0; trailing window endpoint starts at 0; advance per actual non-intervened control step; task-event caps
supervisor_config.return_path_mode: empty gripper only; elevated waypoints; original hold gates and substep contact monitoring; object-pose-consistent
supervisor_config.replay_tracking: original active-arm action plus bounded OSC pose-error feedback at recorded pre-action state; original gripper action retained

A.basis: Revised P0 before closure and before any actual target contacts, collision-enabled geometry distance >20mm in measured prefix; P1 has three closed-command true-grasp states and <1mm relative translation drift. P0 return/replay validation required. Controlled real P0 return/replay/handback and normalized image bridge now passed; later assembly/joint intervals remain unvalidated.

validation_evidence.domain: empty active gripper; target object at measured pick pose; no active contact/coupling; verified quasistatic passive hold; elevated corridor check; physical drift monitored every control step. Not a global path safety certificate.
